title: Croatian Shrimp Spring Rolls
description: A kid friendly Croatian dish featuring shrimp and rice paper sheets, this recipe is gluten free and easy to make.
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the shrimp, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Lay a rice paper sheet flat on a work surface and place about 1/4 cup of the shrimp mixture in the center of the sheet.
Brush the edges of the sheet with water and fold the bottom half up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the sheet to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining sheets and filling.
Place the spring rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with vegetable oil.
Bake the spring rolls for 12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the spring rolls hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Garnish with chopped onion and serve immediately.
